description: This file contains an immutable Java class implementing a JSON Patch mechanism, with methods for creating patches, parsing from JSON strings, and converting to JSON objects. It includes only one class, ImmutableJsonPatch, which models a patch operation applied to JSON data.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonPatch
classes.description: An immutable implementation of a JSON Patch for modifying JSON objects, supporting creation from scratch or JSON strings, and conversion to JSON format.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonPatch instance with specified operation, path, and optional value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to create an ImmutableJsonPatch instance, validating input and extracting operation, path, and optional value.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation type of the JSON Patch.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path indicating where the patch should be applied.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the value to be used in the patch, if any.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the patch into a JSON object including operation, path, and optional value.
